title: drag-lint: Project Rules
summary: Shows the catalog of lint rules in the context of a specific project
intro: Read this when you want the lint rule catalog starting from the Project Manager: right-click a project and choose drag-lint: Project Rules.... From the command line the same list comes from drag-lint rules, and no index is needed.

surfaces.caption: drag-lint: Project Rules
steps: Right-click the project and choose drag-lint: Project Rules...
The lint rule catalog is shown

surfaces.usage: drag-lint rules [--json] [--category <name>] [--rules-dir <dir>] - list every lint rule (catalog)
help: drag-lint rules [--json] [--category <name>] [--rules-dir <dir>]   - list every lint rule (catalog)

questions.ask: Which lint rules apply to this project?
Which rules are in one category?
